title: From A-Z: The Best Labor Day Deals to Shop in 2026
summary: Labor Day weekend is here! ShopBillboard put together a list of deals on fashion, home essentials, shoes, tech and more product categories from retailers across the internet.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

With all of the excitement and fun during the summer of 2026, it’s time to take a break to celebrate the end of the season — especially with the beginning of the fall a few weeks away.

For shoppers, the Labor Day weekend also offers up a chance to save some money online, with Halloween, Black Friday in November and Christmas down the line. With economic worries continuing, retail analysts say shoppers are searching for marked down prices and deals with inflation looming and budgets shrinking.

However, retailers across the internet, like Amazon, Best Buy, Coach Outlet, Dick’s Sporting Goods and others, are boasting deep discounts during Labor Day weekend on all sorts of items, including the latest fashions, footwear, tech, kitchenware, bedroom essentials and more. The holiday isn’t just for cheap mattresses anymore.

In fact, ShopBillboard found the best deals online from different retails from A to Z.

BEST CASUAL FASHION DEALS

Abercrombie & Fitch

Shop Deals Here

For Labor Day weekend, Abercrombie & Fitch is offering up to 40% off apparel for men and women, while the retailer is also offering an additional 20% off list prices on all clearance items. And, orders over $99 can get for free shipping.

BEST OUTLET DEALS

Amazon

Although Amazon just had Prime Day back in June, the retail giant is having another big sale event with up to 45% off list prices for Labor Day. We found vacuum cleaners on sale for up to 40% off, while Beats by Dre headphones are 45% off retail. Plus, select mattresses are marked down by up to 38% off list price. All weekend long, you’ll find deals on fall essentials, end of summer wears, back-to-school tech and much more.

BEST TECH DEALS

Best Buy

Although Best Buy has great deals on tech for Labor Day with savings up to 45% off, the retailer has massive discounts on home appliances from brands, like Samsung, LG, Frigidaire, Bosch and others.

BEST HANDBAG DEALS

Coach Outlet

Shoppers can save up to 70% off select styles for Labor Day, while Coach Outlet is offering an an extra 20% off in savings.

BEST SPORTS DEALS

Dick’s Sporting Goods

For Labor Day, Dick’s Sporting Goods has its annual “Epic Shoe Sale,” which offers up to 30% off select sneaker styles and brands, like Adidas, Nike, On Running and others. Additionally, you can take up to 60% off select clearance items. And, some of the other best deals on the Dick’s website right now: You can get up to 20% off select Under Armour gear.

BEST CRAFTS DEALS

Everlane

Throughout Labor Day weekend, Everlane is offering up to 70% select summer styles for men and women, while shoppers can get an additional 20% off styles too.

BEST MERCH & APPAREL DEALS

Fanatics

With the upcoming 2026 NFL season, starting on Sept. 9, fans can get up to 50% off NFL jerseys and gear for Labor Day weekend on Fanatics. Gear starts as low as just $1.99 for car decals.

BEST MUSIC TEES DEALS

Gap

BEST RUGGED MENSWEAR DEALS

Huckberry

BEST FURNITURE DEALS

IKEA

It might be time to upgrade your home decor. IKEA has a few key deals sitewide during Labor Day. Throughout the holiday weekend, shoppers can save up to 40% off select HEMNES bathroom furniture and fixtures, as well as up to 20% off select TROFAST system storage solutions.

BEST SHOE DEALS

Journeys

BEST HOUSEHOLD GOODS DEALS

Kohl's

At Kohl’s, shoppers get get up to whopping 85% off all clearance items, including men’s and women’s clothing, home essentials, small appliances, beauty, toys and others, throughout Labor Day weekend. Plus, shoppers can also get an extra 50% off select items.

BEST JEANS DEALS

Lee

BEST BEDDINGS DEALS

Macy's

Expiring at the end of the day on Monday, Sept. 7, shoppers can get up to 70% off sitewide for Labor Day. This includes new arrivals and fall fashion essentials, as well as clothing, shoes, handbags, jewelry, home goods, furniture and other catagories.

BEST CLEARANCE DEALS

Nordstrom Rack

With an extra 25% select clearance items, Nordstrom Rack has thousands upon thousands of styles on sale right now, including new markdowns on designer brands like Good American, ASTR the Label, Tommy Hilfiger, Adidas, Cole Haan, Longchamp, Coach and others. There’s also discounts on jewelry too.

BEST CLOTHING ESSENTIALS DEALS

Old Navy

Old Navy’s Labor Day sale offers up to 70% off most items sitewide, including up to 40% off new arrivals for fall. It’s a good time to stock up on basics, while shoppers can get an extra 10% off purchases when signing up for text alerts.

BEST LIFESTYLE APPAREL DEALS

PacSun

Over at PacSun, shoppers can get up to 50% off select items in all categories sitewide. Plus, the retailer is offering free shipping on most orders. Meanwhile, shoppers can also get up to 70% off all clearance items.

BEST RETAIL BUNDLE DEALS

QVC

QVC’s “End-of-Summer” sale is going on now with discounts on select items for up to 50% list and bundle prices. The sale event even includes an additional marked down of up to 50% off clearances items. At QVC, you can save big on fashion, tech, home essentials, patio items and more.

BEST OUTDOOR GEAR DEALS

REI

At REI, it’s time for the retailer’s “Late Summer” sale on men’s and women’s wear, camping essentials, recreation equipment and more with savings up to 50% off list prices. And, if you’re a member of the retailer’s reward program, you can get an additional 20% off one REI Outlet item.

BEST COMFY DEALS

Skechers

Shop these awesome Labor Day deals with Skechers. Through the holiday weekend, shoppers can save up to 40% on select styles sitewide.

BEST HOME ESSENTIALS DEALS

Target

Target has deals on all sorts of items and categories for Labor Day with up to 35% off kitchen items, up to 30% off sports apparel, and up to 20% off organization and storage. Order online and pick it up for free at your nearest Target store location.

BEST LIFESTYLE DEALS

Urban Outfitters

At Urban Outfitters, you can take an extra 40% off all sales items and styles when you purchase online.

BEST ACTIVEWEAR DEALS

Vuori

For activewear, Vuori has a Labor Day sale where shoppers can save up to 40% on select items across categories, such as leggings, joggers, tank tops, jackets, shorts and more.

BEST STREAMING DEALS

Walmart+

BEST DRINKWARE DEALS

Yeti

Over at Yeti, you can save up to 30% off select drinkware and accessories for Labor Day, including mugs, bottles, backpacks, coolers, jugs and more.

BEST SUMMERWEAR DEALS

Zara

Zara’s Labor Day sale marks down men’s and women’s clothes, shoes and fashions by up to 40% off list prices.
